svg.text: The "Judge" Actually Has Three Layers, With Vastly Different Research Attention
The Idea of "Optimizing the Judge to Improve the Whole" Holds to Different Degrees for Different Layers
RLHF, Process Reward PRM, RLVR, Generative Verifier — The Core of the o1 / R1 Route
Extremely Hot: Most Thoroughly Researched → The Argument Does NOT Hold at This Layer
Scoring Judge, Self-Criticism, CRITIC Tool Verification — Has a Dedicated Evaluation Line
Moderately Hot: But Mostly Uses Frozen LLMs as Judges, Rarely "Trains" Them → Partially Holds
Decides How Experiences Are Refined, Which Skills Are Stored, How to Add/Delete/Modify
Nearly Blank: Among 11 Representative Works, Only SkillOS Specifically Trains It → Fully Holds ✅
⚠️ Reverse Risk: When the Judge Itself Is Unreliable, Optimizing It Amplifies Bias (Reward Hacking)

Precise Proposition: Under the Premise of Reliable External Verification (Code Executor/Unit Tests/Human/Verifiable Answers), Making the "Judging-Summarizing" Link a Trainable Object Is a Severely Underestimated Direction
